Each entry must also be an --ignore-vuln flag of the root `security:audit` script, and expires: backend/tests/test_audit_ignores.py fails after the date or once the package is no longer at the listed version in uv.lock, so an exception can never outlive its reason. +++===+++ 2026-10-25 — Hasan Alizada — npm_ignores: the same for pnpm audit (pnpm-workspace.yaml auditConfig.ignoreGhsas; the version is the one in pnpm-lock.yaml).

npm_ignores.reason: No fixed version exists (all of >=4.2.0 <=4.3.1 is affected; 4.3.1 of 2023-03-16 is the latest). Build time only: vite-plugin-pwa > workbox-build > @rollup/plugin-node-resolve merges our own build options with it; it never reaches the browser bundle or the server, and no untrusted input is merged. Added 2026-10-28 (owner decision, option A); on expiry upgrade or replace the parent if a fix exists, otherwise review and extend. Reviewed 2026-11-08 on the deadline (owner, option A): still no fix (advisory updated 2026-10-27, deepmerge latest 4.3.1); @rollup/plugin-node-resolve 16.0.3 (the latest, required by workbox-build 7.4.1, the latest) still depends on it; no drop-in replacement with the same API, so the use is unchanged and the exception is extended by a month.

No fixed version exists (all of <=4.0.7 is affected; 4.0.7 of 2026-08-24 is the latest). Build and development time only: vite, tinyglobby and fdir match file paths against globs of our own configuration; it never reaches the browser bundle or the image (its runtime stage has Python and the built frontend only), and no untrusted glob is ever parsed. Added 2026-11-17 (owner decision, option A, HAAL-184) when the advisory reached the audit database; on expiry upgrade if a fix exists, otherwise review and extend.
